correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Gaussian least-squares projection: S=sum X_i²~chi-square(k), Z~N(0,1), V=R/sigma²~chi-square(k−1) independent; F=[S(u−theta_hat)²+R]/(2k), G=S(u−theta_hat)/k. Substitution gives T0=x−gamma(x−theta)/2+gamma*sigma[Z+V/(Z−d sqrt S)]/(2sqrt S). Conditional normal small-window probability about the pole, dominated by E(V S^−1/2), proves t P(|T0|>t)→C with C=gamma*sigma*Gamma((k+1)/2)/(sqrt(pi)*Gamma(k/2))*(1+d²)^(-(k−1)/2) for k≥2. Student residue decays faster (order t^−k); tail integration proves moment iff q<1. For gradient-squared ridge, the local |u|/(u²+a²) integral yields exactly C/2 times log(1/eps), with chi-square integrable dominating function even k=2. Exact-batch-target cancellation makes affine AR1 with scaled t_k innovations: unique stationary q-moment iff q<k, variance gamma*sigma²/((4−gamma)*(k−2)) for k>2; k=1 gives stationary centered Cauchy scale sigma. All denominators are almost surely nonzero for deterministic x. No inference about the unregularized iterated chain's stationarity or capped SPS.
